name: PunchCard
description: The PunchCard protocol token. PunchCard is building a fair community launchpad for the businesses you love: anyone can launch a token for a local business, its creator fees are held for the owner, and no dev scams. Try it now on the test network at punchcard.club/launchpad. PUNCH's creator fees fund PunchCard's development and audit. Holding PUNCH does not give a share of any fees.
